Registration was relatively easy and straightforward which was great, however that was the only thing that was. )=

For the first 5 months I joined, my regular prescription (which I had discussed and requested from a live doctor live on a live phone call with a live human doctor every single month) was wrong. I got either half of my prescription, 2 days’ worth of my prescription, only one of my prescriptions, or the prescription hadn’t been submitted to the chemist.

I called each time to fix it and have to say that there’s one woman on reception who doesn’t sound like she can be bothered. Across several calls, she didn’t listen, was often argumentative, tried to get me off the phone without any action being taken to fix the problem, rejected my request to complain/ask how to complain, didn’t want me to speak to a doctor, tried to get me to go through the Christmas period without any medication and just didn’t feel helpful.

The other receptionist(s) is lovely, and the doctors have good phone bedside manner.

I finally managed to get a telephone appointment for 0900 today (which I’m grateful for! I know the NHS is struggling, but I’ve been trying for 4 weeks). Called at 1130 as still no call and was told the doctor was behind but couldn’t tell me how much/whether it would be today/when I could expect to not be called anymore. It’s now almost 1830 and I still haven’t had my appointment. Guess I should give up?",null,[0,176]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNScGRPZWh3RRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x70d3926d34802a45!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICRpdOehwE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNScGRPZWh3RRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNScGRPZWh3RRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNScGRPZVJ3EhNDZ3dJellTOG9RWVFzT19obEFFGi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ1JwZE9leHdFEhJDZ3NJajRTOG9RWVF5TU9tQlEiEgkAAAAAAAAAABFFKoA0bZLTcCoTQ2d3SXpZUzhvUVlRc09faGxBRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjY5f780LCTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0QoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,9]]]],"0ahUKEwjY5f780LCTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURU13VnpWZlgxOWZSV2hDZG1Kb1JUbGpSSE5NTW1sd1gxcFBPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEp4WTBObFMyaG1RV2RCV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURabGNMQzRRRRAB",["0x0:0x70d3926d34802a45",null,1696508082705176,1730110646297917,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112464885143518516937/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Paul S","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVTN8VXMPBWvmi44FuIUqRuzkKSCTN7ryuIa8Peewh2HRpaO-i7=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112464885143518516937?hl=en"],"112464885143518516937",null,202,211,null,[1,7,1],114,["Local Guide · 202 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjY5f780LCTAxWPAWMBHRa3BS0Q7LoGCBgoAA"]]]],null,"Edited a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["We have been with the practice since the early 90s and have observed a significant decline in service quality since pre-COVID times. The current management and running of the practice can only be described as poor and ineffective.

I am not criticizing individual staff members who provide the care, but the actual management of the place really need to take a serious look at how they are runnign the place. There are very few experienced GPs left at the practice, if at all. In the last five years, we have not seen the same GP twice, as have typically been seen by a junior or temporary GPs.

It is a real struggle to even get an appointment! I’m sure this would be top complaint by most patients.  You have to be extremely lucky and be one of the first 20 people in the call queue in the morning to secure an appointment in next available slot, which is often three weeks away, or you hope the person before you cancelled their appointment!  We have even tried for over many consecutive days without success to even get an appointment. Even worse, they have now introduced a policy that non-emergency bookings can only be made mid-week. This is complete nonsense and is organized in a way that only frustrates patients who are genuinely seeking medical help. What’s even more useless, if you at the practice in person. e.g. for blood test, you can’t even make ask for GP appointment in person. You are told to call the helpline!

We live in a digital world and other practices in the UK allow for online bookings, never mind take them in person, and have slots within a reasonable time period.
